segments.title: New RenameForm and renamePokemon, modified PartyList and pokemonRouter

traceDiagram.title: List and rename Pokemon flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the app renders the party list with a rename form on each row. It also shows what happens when the user types a name or submits the form, and how the new name reaches the party through the `rename` procedure and `renamePokemon()`.

traceNodes.label: Provides the tRPC and query clients to the app
traceNodes.description: When the browser loads the app, `src/client/main.tsx` renders this component at the root, and the component renders `PartyList` inside `api.Provider`.

children.label: Lists the Pokemon of the party
children.description: When the app renders, [`App` renders this component](code:src/client/App.tsx#L13) inside `api.Provider`, and the component loads the party through `api.pokemon.list.useQuery()`.

children.label: Shows a rename form for one Pokemon
children.description: When the party list renders, [`PartyList` renders this component](code:src/client/PartyList.tsx#L12) on each row, with the id and the name of the Pokemon. When the user types, the change handler stores the draft name. When the user submits, the submit handler sends the draft to the `rename` mutation.

triggerLabels.label: A trainer submits the rename form
A trainer types a new name

blockLabels.label: Keeps the draft name, starting from the current name
Gets the mutation that renames a Pokemon
Renders one row with a rename form per Pokemon

traceNodes.label: Lists, finds and renames Pokemon
traceNodes.description: When the client calls `pokemon.rename`, tRPC finds this router under the key `pokemon` of `appRouter` in `src/server/root.ts`.

children.label: Renames a Pokemon of the signed-in trainer
children.description: When the user submits the rename form, the mutation sends the id and the name to this procedure, and tRPC runs [`requireTrainer`](code:src/server/trpc.ts#L13-16) through `protectedProcedure` before it.

blockLabels.label: Validates a number id and a name of at least one character
Throws FORBIDDEN for a Pokemon of another trainer, then renames the Pokemon
Registers the rename mutation of the router

traceNodes.label: Builds a procedure that runs requireTrainer first
traceNodes.description: When the client calls `pokemon.rename`, tRPC runs the middleware of this procedure before the resolver, because [`rename` is built on `protectedProcedure`](code:src/server/routers/pokemon.ts#L11).

blockLabels.label: Extends the base procedure with a middleware

traceNodes.label: Replaces the name of one Pokemon in the party
traceNodes.description: When the trainer of the Pokemon sends a rename, [the `rename` procedure calls this function](code:src/server/routers/pokemon.ts#L15) with the id and the new name.

blockLabels.label: Copies the Pokemon of the id with the new name

traceNodes.label: Calls the rename procedure on the server
traceNodes.description: When the user submits the form, [the submit handler calls `rename.mutate()`](code:src/client/RenameForm.tsx#L14), and the mutation sends the id and the draft name to the `rename` procedure. When the procedure returns, the mutation runs `onSuccess`.

traceNodes.label: Reloads the party list after a rename
traceNodes.description: When the `rename` procedure returns, React Query calls this `onSuccess` callback, and [the callback invalidates `pokemon.list`](code:src/client/RenameForm.tsx#L8), so `PartyList` loads the party again.

traceNodes.label: Sends the draft name to the rename mutation
traceNodes.description: When the user submits the form, React calls this handler of the form.

Sends the id and the draft name to the mutation

traceNodes.label: Stores the typed name as the draft
traceNodes.description: When the user types in the input, React calls this handler with the change event.
